    # Actor bboxes transformed into ego frame via ego.from_world * actor.to_world.
    for actor in req.actor_to_state.values():
        actor_in_ego = ri.compose_poses(req.ego_state.from_world, actor.to_world)
        corners = _bbox_corners_xy(actor_in_ego, actor.bbox_half_size_m)
        ax.plot(corners[:, 0], corners[:, 1], "r-", linewidth=1)
    return len(req.actor_to_state)


def _radar_detections_xy(req: pb.ReprojectRequest,
                         resp: pb.ReprojectResponse) -> tuple[list[float], list[float]]:
    """Project a reprojected scan's spherical detections into ego-frame XY."""
    R_re = ri.quat_to_rot_matrix(req.radar_param.to_ego.rotation)
    t_re = np.array([req.radar_param.to_ego.translation.x,
                     req.radar_param.to_ego.translation.y,
                     req.radar_param.to_ego.translation.z])
    xs: list[float] = []
    ys: list[float] = []
    for det in resp.scan.detections:
        d, az, el = det.distance_m, det.azimuth_rad, det.elevation_rad
        ce, se = math.cos(el), math.sin(el)
        ca, sa = math.cos(az), math.sin(az)
        ego_xyz = R_re @ np.array([d * ce * ca, d * ce * sa, d * se]) + t_re
        xs.append(ego_xyz[0])
        ys.append(ego_xyz[1])
    return xs, ys


class _FrameViewer:
    """Renders one (ego, radar) frame at a time into a shared top-down window.

    A single figure/axes is reused and cleared on every frame, so each
    reprojected scan is drawn on a fresh plot: the ego + actor bboxes plus that
    radar's detections, in a fixed +-100 m ego-frame view with a grid. The one
    window is shared across all radars selected by ``--radars`` (they cycle
    through it). When ``output_dir`` is set each frame is written to
    ``<output_dir>/<radar_id>/scan_<index>.png``, where ``index`` is the
    request's position in the merged scan schedule. The caller only constructs
    a viewer when at least one of live/output is enabled.
    """

    def __init__(self, live: bool, output_dir: pathlib.Path | None,
                 header: str = "") -> None:
        import matplotlib
        # Only force the headless Agg backend when purely saving PNGs; live
        # display needs whatever interactive backend is available.
        if not live:
            matplotlib.use("Agg")
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

        self._plt = plt
        self._live = live
        self._output_dir = output_dir
        self._header = header          # first title line (clip id, ego shift)
        self._radar_colors: dict[str, tuple] = {}   # radar_id -> stable color
        # Optional (logged, shifted-or-None) ego trajectories, Nx3 world points.
        self._ego_trajectories: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray | None] | None = None
        self._fig, self._ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 10))
        mgr = self._fig.canvas.manager
        if mgr is not None:
            mgr.set_window_title("radar reprojection")
        if live:
            plt.ion()
            self._fig.show()

    def set_ego_trajectories(self, logged_world: np.ndarray,
                             shifted_world: np.ndarray | None = None) -> None:
        """Overlay ego trajectories (Nx3 world points; shifted one optional)."""
        self._ego_trajectories = (logged_world, shifted_world)

    def _color_for(self, radar_id: str) -> tuple:
        color = self._radar_colors.get(radar_id)
        if color is None:
            cmap = self._plt.get_cmap("tab10")
            color = cmap(len(self._radar_colors) % cmap.N)
            self._radar_colors[radar_id] = color
        return color

    def render(self, req: pb.ReprojectRequest, resp: pb.ReprojectResponse,
               scan_index: int) -> None:
        from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
        ax = self._ax
        ax.clear()                              # fresh plot every frame
        _setup_axes(ax)
        n_actors = _draw_ego_and_actors(ax, req)
        xs, ys = _radar_detections_xy(req, resp)
        color = self._color_for(req.radar_param.id)
        ax.scatter(xs, ys, s=4, color=color, zorder=3)

        handles = [Line2D([], [], color="blue", linewidth=2)]
        labels = ["ego"]
        if n_actors:
            handles.append(Line2D([], [], color="red", linewidth=1))
            labels.append(f"actors ({n_actors})")
        if self._ego_trajectories is not None:
            logged_w, shifted_w = self._ego_trajectories
            series = [(logged_w, "black", "--", "ego traj (logged)")]
            if shifted_w is not None:
                series.append((shifted_w, "magenta", "-", "ego traj (shifted)"))
            for pts_w, traj_color, ls, label in series:
                xy = _world_to_ego_xy(req.ego_state.from_world, pts_w)
                ax.plot(xy[:, 0], xy[:, 1], color=traj_color, linestyle=ls,
                        linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.8, zorder=2)
                handles.append(Line2D([], [], color=traj_color, linestyle=ls,
                                      linewidth=1.2))
                labels.append(label)
        handles.append(Line2D([], [], marker="o", linestyle="",
                              color=color, markersize=4))
        labels.append(f"{req.radar_param.id} ({len(xs)})")
        ax.legend(handles=handles, labels=labels, loc="upper right",
                  fontsize="small")
        title = f"{req.radar_param.id}  t={req.timestamp_us} us"
        if self._header:
            title = f"{self._header}\n{title}"
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=10)

        if self._output_dir is not None:
            png = self._output_dir / req.radar_param.id / f"scan_{scan_index:05d}.png"
            png.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self._fig.savefig(png, dpi=80)
        if self._live:
            self._fig.canvas.draw_idle()
            self._plt.pause(_LIVE_PAUSE_S)

    def close(self, block: bool) -> None:
        # When live, keep the final frame on screen until the user closes it.
        if self._live and block:
            self._plt.ioff()
            self._plt.show()
        self._plt.close("all")


def _make_dummy_reprojector(log_data: pb.LogData):
    """Return a stub.Reproject stand-in that echoes the original logged scan.

    Requests are generated from the logged scans themselves, so the exact
    (radar id, timestamp) scan always exists. The response uses the regular
    ReprojectResponse shape, so plotting and summaries work unchanged.
    """
    lookup = {
        (radar_id, scan.timestamp_us): scan
        for radar_id, rec in log_data.log_radar_data.items()
        for scan in rec.scans
    }

    def reproject(req: pb.ReprojectRequest) -> pb.ReprojectResponse:
        scan = lookup.get((req.radar_param.id, req.timestamp_us))
        if scan is None:
            raise KeyError(f"no logged scan for {req.radar_param.id} "
                           f"at t={req.timestamp_us}us")
        resp = pb.ReprojectResponse()
        resp.scan.CopyFrom(scan)
        return resp

    return reproject


def _resolve_workspace_path(p: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path:
    # Under `bazel run`, cwd is the runfiles dir; relative user-supplied paths
    # like `sample_data` won't resolve. Bazel exposes the original workspace
    # root via BUILD_WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY for exactly this case.
    if p.is_absolute():
        return p
    workspace = os.environ.get("BUILD_WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY")
    return pathlib.Path(workspace) / p if workspace else p


def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    p.add_argument("--address", default="localhost:50051")
    p.add_argument("--dataset-root", type=pathlib.Path, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--clip", required=True, help="Clip UUID, e.g. 25cd4769-...")
    p.add_argument("--intrinsics-config", type=pathlib.Path, required=True,
                   help="Path to config/radar_intrinsics.json")
    p.add_argument("--radars", nargs="*", default=None,
                   help="Restrict to a subset of radar ids (default: all).")
    p.add_argument("--ego-shift", nargs=3, type=float, default=None,
                   metavar=("LAT_M", "LON_M", "HEADING_DEG"),
                   help="Request reprojection from a pose offset from the "
                        "logged ego pose, given in the ego frame: lateral "
                        "metres (+left), longitudinal metres (+forward), "
                        "heading degrees (+counter-clockwise). A pure pose "
                        "shift: the logged world-frame ego velocity is kept, "
                        "and actors stay on their logged trajectories. When "
                        "plotting, the logged and shifted ego trajectories "
                        "are overlaid on every frame.")
    p.add_argument("--dummy", action="store_true",
                   help="Dummy reprojection: skip the server entirely and "
                        "answer each request with the exact original logged "
                        "scan for that radar and timestamp, in the regular "
                        "response format. All downstream functionality "
                        "(plotting, summaries) works unchanged; useful as an "
                        "identity baseline and to visualize the raw log.")
    p.add_argument("--plot-output-dir", type=pathlib.Path, default=None,
                   help="If set, save each frame as "
                        "<dir>/<radar_id>/scan_<index>.png.")
    p.add_argument("--show", action="store_true",
                   help="Show an interactive top-down plot that updates on the "
                        "fly as each radar scan is reprojected. Can be "
                        "combined with --plot-output-dir.")
    p.add_argument("--plot-every", type=int, default=1,
                   help="Plot every N-th scan (default 1). Used when "
                        "--plot-output-dir and/or --show is set.")
    return p.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    args = parse_args()
    dataset_root = _resolve_workspace_path(args.dataset_root)
    intrinsics_config = _resolve_workspace_path(args.intrinsics_config)
    plot_dir = (_resolve_workspace_path(args.plot_output_dir)
                if args.plot_output_dir is not None else None)
    if args.plot_every <= 0:
        print("--plot-every must be a positive integer", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    title_header = f"clip {args.clip}"
    if args.dummy:
        title_header += "   dummy: original scans"
    if args.ego_shift is not None:
        s_lat, s_lon, s_hdg = args.ego_shift
        title_header += (f"   ego-shift: lat {s_lat:+g} m, "
                         f"lon {s_lon:+g} m, heading {s_hdg:+g} deg")
    viewer = (_FrameViewer(live=args.show, output_dir=plot_dir,
                           header=title_header)
              if (args.show or plot_dir is not None) else None)

    adapter_obj = paa.PhysicalAIAVAdapter(
        dataset_root=dataset_root,
        clip_uuid=args.clip,
        intrinsics_config=intrinsics_config,
        radar_allowlist=args.radars or None,
    )

    print(f"Loading {args.clip} from {dataset_root} ...", flush=True)
    log_data = adapter_obj.load_log_data()
    radar_ids = sorted(log_data.log_radar_data)
    unknown_radars = sorted(set(args.radars or []) - set(radar_ids))
    if unknown_radars:
        print(f"Unknown radar id(s) for clip {args.clip}: {', '.join(unknown_radars)}",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    n_ego = len(log_data.log_actor_data.ego_trajectory.states)
    n_radars = len(radar_ids)
    n_scans = sum(len(rec.scans) for rec in log_data.log_radar_data.values())
    print(f"Loaded: {n_ego} ego states, {n_radars} radars, {n_scans} scans, "
          f"{len(log_data.log_actor_data.actor_to_trajectory)} actors", flush=True)
    print(f"Radars: {', '.join(radar_ids)}", flush=True)

    ego_shift = None
    if args.ego_shift is not None:
        if args.dummy:
            print("warning: --dummy echoes the original scans; --ego-shift "
                  "only moves the plot frame, so detections will not match "
                  "the shifted pose.", file=sys.stderr)
        lat_m, lon_m, heading_deg = args.ego_shift
        ego_shift = ri.make_planar_shift_pose(lat_m, lon_m,
                                              math.radians(heading_deg))
        print(f"Ego shift: lateral {lat_m:+g} m (left+), "
              f"longitudinal {lon_m:+g} m (forward+), "
              f"heading {heading_deg:+g} deg (CCW+)", flush=True)

    if viewer is not None and (ego_shift is not None or args.dummy):
        # Overlay the logged (and, with --ego-shift, the shifted) ego
        # trajectory on every frame.
        ego_states = sorted(log_data.log_actor_data.ego_trajectory.states,
                            key=lambda s: s.timestamp_us)
        logged_w = np.array([[s.to_world.translation.x,
                              s.to_world.translation.y,
                              s.to_world.translation.z]
                             for s in ego_states])
        shifted_w = None
        if ego_shift is not None:
            shifted_w = np.array([[p.translation.x, p.translation.y,
                                   p.translation.z]
                                  for p in (ri.compose_poses(s.to_world, ego_shift)
                                            for s in ego_states)])
        viewer.set_ego_trajectories(logged_w, shifted_w)

    total_dets = 0
    i_scan = 0

    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        if args.dummy:
            print("Dummy mode: echoing original logged scans; no server used.",
                  flush=True)
            reproject = _make_dummy_reprojector(log_data)
        else:
            ch = stack.enter_context(
                grpc.insecure_channel(args.address, options=GRPC_OPTS))
            stub = pb_grpc.RadarReprojectorServiceStub(ch)
            init_req = pb.InitializeRequest(
                param=adapter_obj.reprojector_param(),
                log_data=log_data,
            )
            try:
                stub.Initialize(init_req)
            except grpc.RpcError as e:
                print(f"Initialize failed: {e.code().name} {e.details()}",
                      file=sys.stderr)
                return 1
            reproject = stub.Reproject

        for req in ri.iter_reproject_requests(log_data, ego_shift=ego_shift):
            i_scan += 1
            try:
                resp = reproject(req)
            except grpc.RpcError as e:
                print(f"Reproject failed at scan {i_scan}/{n_scans} "
                      f"radar={req.radar_param.id}: {e.code().name} {e.details()}",
                      file=sys.stderr)
                return 1
            n = len(resp.scan.detections)
            print(f"[scan {i_scan}/{n_scans}  t={req.timestamp_us}us] "
                  f"{req.radar_param.id} -> {n} detections")

            if viewer is not None and (i_scan - 1) % args.plot_every == 0:
                viewer.render(req, resp, i_scan)

            total_dets += n

    skipped = n_scans - i_scan
    print(f"Done. {i_scan} logged scans reprojected across {n_radars} radars, "
          f"{total_dets} detections total."
          + (f" ({skipped} scans outside the ego trajectory window skipped.)"
             if skipped else ""))

    if viewer is not None:
        # Block on the final live frame (if any) until the window is closed.
        viewer.close(block=args.show)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""PhysicalAI-AV concrete data adapter.

Mirrors dataset/PhysicalAIAVLoader.cpp: same parquet layout, same column
names, same coordinate conventions. Loads on first load_log_data() call and
caches the result.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import pathlib
from typing import Optional

import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.compute as pc
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from examples.python import adapter, reproject_iter as ri
from proto import radar_reprojector_pb2 as pb


class PhysicalAIAVAdapter(adapter.RadarReprojectionDataAdapter):
    def __init__(
        self,
        dataset_root: pathlib.Path,
        clip_uuid: str,
        intrinsics_config: pathlib.Path,
        radar_allowlist: Optional[list[str]] = None,
        reprojector_param: Optional[pb.ReprojectorParam] = None,
    ):
        self._dataset_root = pathlib.Path(dataset_root)
        self._clip_uuid = clip_uuid
        self._intrinsics_config = pathlib.Path(intrinsics_config)
        self._radar_allowlist = radar_allowlist
        self._reprojector_param = (
            reprojector_param
            if reprojector_param is not None
            else adapter.default_reprojector_param()
        )
        self._cached: Optional[pb.LogData] = None

    def reprojector_param(self) -> pb.ReprojectorParam:
        out = pb.ReprojectorParam()
        out.CopyFrom(self._reprojector_param)
        return out

    def load_log_data(self) -> pb.LogData:
        if self._cached is not None:
            return self._cached
        log_data = pb.LogData()

        extrinsics = self._load_extrinsics()
        dims = self._load_vehicle_dims()
        bbox_half = pb.Vec3f(x=0.5 * dims["length"],
                             y=0.5 * dims["width"],
                             z=0.5 * dims["height"])

        log_data.log_actor_data.ego_trajectory.CopyFrom(
            self._build_ego_trajectory(bbox_half))
        for actor_id, traj in self._build_actor_trajectories(
                log_data.log_actor_data.ego_trajectory).items():
            log_data.log_actor_data.actor_to_trajectory[actor_id].CopyFrom(traj)

        intr_table = self._load_intrinsics_config()
        for radar_id in self._radar_dirs():
            param = self._make_radar_param(radar_id, extrinsics, intr_table)
            rec = self._build_radar_recording(radar_id, param)
            param.max_num_returns = max(
                (len(scan.detections) for scan in rec.scans), default=0)
            rec.param.CopyFrom(param)
            log_data.log_radar_data[radar_id].CopyFrom(rec)

        self._cached = log_data
        return log_data

    # --- helpers used by the per-feature loaders in later tasks ------------

    def _radar_dirs(self) -> list[str]:
        radar_root = self._dataset_root / "radar"
        if not radar_root.exists():
            return []
        radars: list[str] = []
        for entry in sorted(radar_root.iterdir()):
            if not entry.is_dir():
                continue
            radar_id = entry.name
            f = entry / f"{self._clip_uuid}.{radar_id}.parquet"
            if f.exists():
                if self._radar_allowlist and radar_id not in self._radar_allowlist:
                    continue
                radars.append(radar_id)
        return radars

    def _read_clip_calibration(self, subdir: pathlib.Path) -> pa.Table:
        """Rows of every calibration chunk under `subdir` whose clip_id is this clip.

        Calibration is stored per dataset chunk, and a dataset root holding
        several clips can hold several chunk files. Every `*.parquet` is
        searched regardless of sort order; the error names the clip and the
        files searched so a missing download is easy to tell apart.
        """
        if not subdir.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"PhysicalAIAVAdapter: directory missing: {subdir}")
        files = sorted(f for f in subdir.iterdir() if f.suffix == ".parquet")
        if not files:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"PhysicalAIAVAdapter: no .parquet under {subdir}")
        matches = []
        for f in files:
            table = pq.read_table(str(f))
            rows = table.filter(pc.equal(table.column("clip_id"), self._clip_uuid))
            if rows.num_rows:
                matches.append(rows)
        if not matches:
            names = ", ".join(f.name for f in files)
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"PhysicalAIAVAdapter: no calibration rows for clip {self._clip_uuid} "
                f"under {subdir}; searched {len(files)} chunk file(s): {names}. "
                f"Download the clip's calibration chunk into this dataset root.")
        return pa.concat_tables(matches)

    def _load_intrinsics_config(self) -> dict[str, dict]:
        with open(self._intrinsics_config, "r") as f:
            return json.load(f)

    @staticmethod
    def _lookup_intrinsics(radar_id: str, intrinsics_table: dict[str, dict]) -> dict:
        """Longest-suffix match against the intrinsics_table keys.

        Mirrors RadarIntrinsicsConfig::lookup in dataset/RadarIntrinsicsConfig.cpp:
        try every key, pick the longest one whose value is a suffix of radar_id.
        Fall back to "srr_0" if no key matches.
        """
        best_key: Optional[str] = None
        for key in intrinsics_table:
            if radar_id.endswith(key) and (best_key is None or len(key) > len(best_key)):
                best_key = key
        if best_key is None:
            if "srr_0" in intrinsics_table:
                return intrinsics_table["srr_0"]
            raise KeyError(
                f"radar_intrinsics.json has no suffix match for radar id '{radar_id}' "
                f"and no 'srr_0' fallback configured.")
        return intrinsics_table[best_key]

    def _load_extrinsics(self) -> dict[str, pb.Pose]:
        table = self._read_clip_calibration(
            self._dataset_root / "calibration" / "sensor_extrinsics")
        sensor_col = table.column("sensor_name").to_pylist()
        qx = table.column("qx").to_pylist(); qy = table.column("qy").to_pylist()
        qz = table.column("qz").to_pylist(); qw = table.column("qw").to_pylist()
        x  = table.column("x").to_pylist();  y  = table.column("y").to_pylist()
        z  = table.column("z").to_pylist()
        out: dict[str, pb.Pose] = {}
        for i in range(table.num_rows):
            p = pb.Pose()
            p.translation.x = float(x[i]); p.translation.y = float(y[i]); p.translation.z = float(z[i])
            # Normalize the quaternion to be defensive against minor float drift.
            qx_i, qy_i, qz_i, qw_i = float(qx[i]), float(qy[i]), float(qz[i]), float(qw[i])
            norm = (qx_i*qx_i + qy_i*qy_i + qz_i*qz_i + qw_i*qw_i) ** 0.5 or 1.0
            p.rotation.x = qx_i / norm; p.rotation.y = qy_i / norm
            p.rotation.z = qz_i / norm; p.rotation.w = qw_i / norm
            out[sensor_col[i]] = p
        return out

    def _load_vehicle_dims(self) -> dict[str, float]:
        table = self._read_clip_calibration(
            self._dataset_root / "calibration" / "vehicle_dimensions")
        return {
            "length": float(table.column("length")[0].as_py()),
            "width":  float(table.column("width")[0].as_py()),
            "height": float(table.column("height")[0].as_py()),
        }

    def _build_ego_trajectory(self, bbox_half: pb.Vec3f) -> pb.ActorTrajectory:
        path = (self._dataset_root / "labels" / "egomotion" /
                f"{self._clip_uuid}.egomotion.parquet")
        table = pq.read_table(str(path))
        t  = table.column("timestamp").to_pylist()
        qx = table.column("qx").to_pylist(); qy = table.column("qy").to_pylist()
        qz = table.column("qz").to_pylist(); qw = table.column("qw").to_pylist()
        x  = table.column("x").to_pylist();  y  = table.column("y").to_pylist()
        z  = table.column("z").to_pylist()
        vx = table.column("vx").to_pylist(); vy = table.column("vy").to_pylist()
        vz = table.column("vz").to_pylist()

        rows = []
        for i in range(len(t)):
            rows.append((int(t[i]),
                         float(qx[i]), float(qy[i]), float(qz[i]), float(qw[i]),
                         float(x[i]),  float(y[i]),  float(z[i]),
                         float(vx[i]), float(vy[i]), float(vz[i])))
        rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])

        traj = pb.ActorTrajectory()
        for (ts, rx, ry, rz, rw, tx, ty, tz, vxi, vyi, vzi) in rows:
            s = traj.states.add()
            s.timestamp_us = ts
            norm = (rx*rx + ry*ry + rz*rz + rw*rw) ** 0.5 or 1.0
            s.to_world.rotation.x = rx / norm
            s.to_world.rotation.y = ry / norm
            s.to_world.rotation.z = rz / norm
            s.to_world.rotation.w = rw / norm
            s.to_world.translation.x = tx
            s.to_world.translation.y = ty
            s.to_world.translation.z = tz
            s.from_world.CopyFrom(ri.invert_pose(s.to_world))
            s.velocity_mps.x = vxi
            s.velocity_mps.y = vyi
            s.velocity_mps.z = vzi
            s.bbox_half_size_m.CopyFrom(bbox_half)
            # bbox_center_m left zeroed (matches EgoTrajectoryBuilder.cpp:89).
        return traj

    def _build_actor_trajectories(
        self,
        ego_trajectory: pb.ActorTrajectory,
    ) -> dict[str, pb.ActorTrajectory]:
        path = (self._dataset_root / "labels" / "obstacle.offline" /
                f"{self._clip_uuid}.obstacle.offline.parquet")
        table = pq.read_table(str(path))
        ts_col = table.column("timestamp_us").to_pylist()
        id_col = table.column("track_id").to_pylist()
        cx = table.column("center_x").to_pylist(); cy = table.column("center_y").to_pylist()
        cz = table.column("center_z").to_pylist()
        sx = table.column("size_x").to_pylist();   sy = table.column("size_y").to_pylist()
        sz = table.column("size_z").to_pylist()
        ox = table.column("orientation_x").to_pylist(); oy = table.column("orientation_y").to_pylist()
        oz = table.column("orientation_z").to_pylist(); ow = table.column("orientation_w").to_pylist()

        out: dict[str, pb.ActorTrajectory] = {}
        for i in range(len(ts_col)):
            t = int(ts_col[i])
            track_id = id_col[i]
            ego_at_t = ri.slerp_actor_state(ego_trajectory, t)
            if ego_at_t is None:
                # Skip obstacles whose timestamp falls outside the ego window.
                # NOTE: dataset/detail/EgoInterpolator.cpp clamps to the
                # endpoint instead. Python skips by design (matches the
                # iter_reproject_requests skip-on-out-of-range policy and
                # avoids fabricating world-frame poses from extrapolated
                # ego data at clip edges).
                continue
            actor_to_ego = pb.Pose()
            actor_to_ego.translation.x = float(cx[i])
            actor_to_ego.translation.y = float(cy[i])
            actor_to_ego.translation.z = float(cz[i])
            qxi, qyi, qzi, qwi = float(ox[i]), float(oy[i]), float(oz[i]), float(ow[i])
            qnorm = (qxi*qxi + qyi*qyi + qzi*qzi + qwi*qwi) ** 0.5 or 1.0
            actor_to_ego.rotation.x = qxi / qnorm
            actor_to_ego.rotation.y = qyi / qnorm
            actor_to_ego.rotation.z = qzi / qnorm
            actor_to_ego.rotation.w = qwi / qnorm
            actor_to_world = ri.compose_poses(ego_at_t.to_world, actor_to_ego)

            traj = out.setdefault(track_id, pb.ActorTrajectory())
            s = traj.states.add()
            s.timestamp_us = t
            s.to_world.CopyFrom(actor_to_world)
            s.from_world.CopyFrom(ri.invert_pose(actor_to_world))
            # velocity filled below with finite differences.
            s.bbox_half_size_m.x = 0.5 * float(sx[i])
            s.bbox_half_size_m.y = 0.5 * float(sy[i])
            s.bbox_half_size_m.z = 0.5 * float(sz[i])
            # bbox_center_m left zeroed (matches ActorTrajectoryBuilder.cpp:126).

        for traj in out.values():
            traj.states.sort(key=lambda s: s.timestamp_us)
            self._fill_finite_diff_velocity(traj)
        return out

    def _build_radar_recording(
        self,
        radar_id: str,
        param: pb.RadarParam,
    ) -> pb.LogRecording:
        path = (self._dataset_root / "radar" / radar_id /
                f"{self._clip_uuid}.{radar_id}.parquet")
        table = pq.read_table(str(path))
        scan_idx_col = table.column("scan_index").to_pylist()
        ts_col       = table.column("timestamp").to_pylist()
        det_idx_col  = table.column("detection_index").to_pylist()
        az_col       = table.column("azimuth").to_pylist()
        el_col       = table.column("elevation").to_pylist()
        d_col        = table.column("distance").to_pylist()
        rv_col       = table.column("radial_velocity").to_pylist()
        rcs_col      = table.column("rcs").to_pylist()

        rec = pb.LogRecording()
        rec.param.CopyFrom(param)
        cur_scan_idx = -1
        cur_scan: Optional[pb.RadarScan] = None
        for i in range(len(scan_idx_col)):
            si = int(scan_idx_col[i])
            if si != cur_scan_idx:
                cur_scan_idx = si
                cur_scan = rec.scans.add()
                cur_scan.timestamp_us = int(ts_col[i])
            det = cur_scan.detections.add()
            det.azimuth_rad         = float(az_col[i])
            det.elevation_rad       = float(el_col[i])
            det.distance_m          = float(d_col[i])
            det.radial_velocity_mps = float(rv_col[i])
            det.rcs_dbm             = float(rcs_col[i])
            det.reference.radar_id        = radar_id
            det.reference.scan_index      = si
            det.reference.detection_index = int(det_idx_col[i])
            det.reference.actor_id        = ""
            # vel_in_world left zeroed (filled by reproject path on the C++ side).
        return rec

    def _make_radar_param(
        self,
        radar_id: str,
        extrinsics: dict[str, pb.Pose],
        intrinsics_table: dict[str, dict],
    ) -> pb.RadarParam:
        param = pb.RadarParam()
        param.id = radar_id
        intr = self._lookup_intrinsics(radar_id, intrinsics_table)
        param.intrinsics.min_range_m   = float(intr["minRangeM"])
        param.intrinsics.max_range_m   = float(intr["maxRangeM"])
        param.intrinsics.half_hfov_rad = float(intr["halfHfovRad"])
        param.intrinsics.half_vfov_rad = float(intr["halfVfovRad"])
        param.intrinsics.hfov_res_rad  = float(intr["hfovResRad"])
        param.intrinsics.vfov_res_rad  = float(intr["vfovResRad"])
        param.intrinsics.range_res_m   = float(intr["rangeResM"])
        if radar_id in extrinsics:
            param.to_ego.CopyFrom(extrinsics[radar_id])
        else:
            param.to_ego.rotation.w = 1.0  # identity
        param.max_num_returns = 0  # filled in load_log_data after scan build
        return param

    @staticmethod
    def _fill_finite_diff_velocity(traj: pb.ActorTrajectory) -> None:
        n = len(traj.states)
        if n == 0:
            return
        if n == 1:
            traj.states[0].velocity_mps.x = 0.0
            traj.states[0].velocity_mps.y = 0.0
            traj.states[0].velocity_mps.z = 0.0
            return
        def _pos(i):
            t = traj.states[i].to_world.translation
            return (t.x, t.y, t.z)
        def _dt(i, j):
            return max((traj.states[j].timestamp_us - traj.states[i].timestamp_us) * 1e-6, 1e-6)
        # endpoints
        p0, p1 = _pos(0), _pos(1)
        dt01 = _dt(0, 1)
        traj.states[0].velocity_mps.x = (p1[0] - p0[0]) / dt01
        traj.states[0].velocity_mps.y = (p1[1] - p0[1]) / dt01
        traj.states[0].velocity_mps.z = (p1[2] - p0[2]) / dt01
        pe0, pe1 = _pos(n - 2), _pos(n - 1)
        dte = _dt(n - 2, n - 1)
        traj.states[n - 1].velocity_mps.x = (pe1[0] - pe0[0]) / dte
        traj.states[n - 1].velocity_mps.y = (pe1[1] - pe0[1]) / dte
        traj.states[n - 1].velocity_mps.z = (pe1[2] - pe0[2]) / dte
        # interior — central difference. We use `pb_` (with underscore) for
        # the right-bracketing position because `pb` would shadow the proto
        # module imported at the top of the file.
        for i in range(1, n - 1):
            pa, pb_ = _pos(i - 1), _pos(i + 1)
            dti = _dt(i - 1, i + 1)
            traj.states[i].velocity_mps.x = (pb_[0] - pa[0]) / dti
            traj.states[i].velocity_mps.y = (pb_[1] - pa[1]) / dti
            traj.states[i].velocity_mps.z = (pb_[2] - pa[2]) / dti
